title: LightPath Technologies to Participate in the 28th Annual Needham Growth Conference on January 15, 2026
author: Prnewswire
description: LightPath Technologies (NASDAQ:LPTH) announced it will participate in the 28th Annual Needham Growth Conference on January 15, 2026, hosting one-on-one virtual meetings with institutional investors. The company highlighted its strengthened balance sheet following a recent financing and plans to discuss its defense and commercial optics platforms and strategic priorities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively engaging with institutional investors at a major growth conference, recently completed successful financing, and management expressed confidence in advancing strategic priorities and creating shareholder value. The tone is optimistic about market opportunities and the company's strengthened financial position.

title: LightPath Technologies to Attend Association of the United States Army (AUSA) 2024 Annual Meeting & Exposition on October 14-16, 2024
author: Prnewswire
description: LightPath Technologies, a leading provider of next-generation optics and imaging systems, announced its participation in the AUSA 2024 Annual Meeting and Exposition. The company plans to showcase its portfolio of products, including its recently qualified advanced thermal camera system, and discuss potential business opportunities with defense industry leaders.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article highlights LightPath's participation in a major defense industry event, its portfolio of next-generation products, and a significant contract win with Lockheed Martin, indicating the company's strong position in the market.

title: LightPath Technologies Reports Fiscal 2024 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Financial Results
author: Prnewswire
description: LightPath Technologies reported a net loss of $8 million for fiscal 2024, primarily due to lower revenue and gross margin, as well as increased operating expenses. The company saw a decrease in sales of visible components, partially offset by increases in infrared components and engineering services.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company reported a net loss of $8 million for the fiscal year, with decreases in revenue and gross margin, as well as increased operating expenses.
